title: Watchtower
weakText: Weak passwords are easier to guess. Generate strong passwords to keep your accounts safe.
reusedText: If one site leaks a password you use elsewhere, those accounts are at risk too. Use a different password for each.
unsecuredText: These logins use http:// addresses, which send your password without encryption. Switch to https:// if the site supports it.
expiringText: Cards and documents that expire within 30 days, or already have.
intro: Security problems in your items. Everything is checked on this device; nothing is sent anywhere.
breachOff: Off. Turn it on in Settings › Privacy to check your passwords against known data breaches.
breachText: Checks your logins' passwords against haveibeenpwned.com. Only the first 5 characters of each password's hash are sent.
breachNone: None of your passwords appear in known data breaches.
